g.text: Heldout: generic engine policies under frozen quality bands
These curves restrict generic choices to engines; ordinary recipe choices are analyzed separately.

Relative denominator: feasible common bases. Absolute denominator: all common bases. Development estimates fit on development. Heldout curves apply development-selected subsets and trees without refitting.
